# Papered v0.2.1 — Sync & Indexing Stability (Alpha)

> **⚠️ Alpha Notice**
> This is an early, experimental release. The API, CLI, data format, and database schema are subject to breaking changes without notice. Not recommended for production use.

This release hardens the Zotero sync → import → indexing pipeline end to end: sync now surfaces failures instead of dying silently, indexing can be paused and resumed, slow LLM providers get proper retry backoff, and a renderer panic can no longer sink a whole paper.

## Highlights

- **Pause / resume indexing** — A pause toggle (Settings → Indexing, or the global badge in the top bar) stops the worker pool between jobs and survives daemon restarts via a persisted flag file. New endpoint: `POST /api/v1/index-queue/pause`.
- **Failure visibility** — Import-queue items now carry the paper title and a failure reason; failed entries show a red error line (with tooltip) and link to the paper. `do_reindex` writes status through the status update path, so a reindexed paper no longer reports "processing" while the database still says "failed".
- **LLM retry backoff** — Chat, embedding, and reranker calls share a retry core: transient errors back off exponentially (1s doubling, 30s cap, jittered down to 50–100% of the nominal delay so concurrent retries spread, honoring Retry-After), while hard 4xx errors fail fast.
- **Resilient PDF figure extraction** — A panic while rendering a figure via pdf_oxide degrades to a warning plus an empty figure list instead of failing the whole paper; the paper completes indexing with text only.

## Graph view

- **Show all papers** — The Papers selector gains an "All" option that renders every indexed paper (up to the 1000-node backend cap), instead of capping out at 500.
- **Instant, settled layout** — The force-directed simulation now converges synchronously before the first paint: the graph appears already settled instead of visibly jittering for ~10 seconds.
- **Smooth wheel zoom** — Zoom scales by the actual wheel delta (trackpads and mice now behave alike), the range widens to 0.03–8×, and the initial view auto-fits the whole graph into the viewport — no more "too big or too small" fighting.
- **Adaptive node sizing** — Node radius is scaled relative to the most-connected node in the current graph (4–9px range), so raising "Links/paper" no longer inflates every node at once and hubs no longer dominate.

## Fixes

- **Sync now actually imports** — The Zotero 302 redirect to `file://` that panicked the sync worker is caught; sync error paths in the UI now show an actionable error block with a Retry button instead of spinning forever.
- **UI no longer freezes during indexing** — CPU-bound work (PDF parsing, hashing, chunking, cover rendering) moved to the blocking pool; the Turso store splits read/write connections so the single connection is no longer a mutual-exclusion bottleneck.
- **Daemon log rotation** — `daemon.log` rotates at 50MB (one `.1` backup) at startup; the log itself is no longer lost for CLI-spawned daemons.
- **`papered stop` always works** — The daemon's graceful shutdown is bounded by a 10s grace period (SSE/MCP streams and long indexing requests can no longer hang it forever), and the CLI escalates to SIGKILL plus stale-file cleanup when the grace expires. `papered reset` waits for the daemon to actually exit before deleting the database.
- **Memory: no more unbounded RSS growth** — Turso is updated to 0.7.2 with the mimalloc feature disabled; sustained indexing no longer grows RSS monotonically (measured: memory now returns to the OS instead of climbing 105MB → 3.9GB over 5h).
- **Cover thumbnails** — Higher-resolution thumbnails (600px long side) for Retina displays; regenerable via `POST /api/v1/health/regenerate-covers`.

## New settings

- **Indexing concurrency** — Configurable 1–16 in Settings → Indexing (saved via config; a restart hint is shown when it takes effect).

## Misc

- Queue list is scrollable (max 100 visible + "and N more"); Data quality / Integrity pages show paper titles and scroll instead of overflowing.
- **Codebase cleanup** — Removed dead code (unused error constructors, a 100-line dead batch-translation path, unused API client methods and CSS rules), merged three Lanczos3 resizers and duplicated PNG header parsers into shared helpers, and consolidated the Lattice/Zotero auto-sync spawners and sync-scope config saves into single shared routines.
